events.title: Buy-back of ordinary shares in BONESUPPORT HOLDING AB October 19-23, 2026 (week 43)
events.text: BONESUPPORT HOLDING AB (LEI CODE: 549300COLY053IGTLD63) ("BONESUPPORT") has during October 19, 2026 up to and including October 23, 2026 repurchased a total of 25,000 own ordinary shares (ISIN: SE0009858152) as part of the buy-back program initiated by BONESUPPORT on September 1, 2026. The repurchases are part of the buy-back program of maximum SEK 100 million announced by BONESUPPORT on September 1, 2026 and which started on September 1, 2026 and will end no later than October 30, 2026. The buy-back program is carried out for the purpose of adapting BONESUPPORT’s capital structure to the company’s capital needs and thereby contribute to increased shareholder value. The repurchases are carried out in accordance with the Market Abuse Regulation (EU) 596/2014 ("MAR") and the European Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2016/1052 (the "Safe Harbour Regulation"). Ordinary shares in BONESUPPORT have been repurchased as follows: +--------------------+------------------+----------------+-------------------+ | Date | Aggregate daily | Weighted | Total Daily | | | volume (number | average price | Transaction Value | | | of shares) | per day (SEK) | (SEK) | +--------------------+------------------+----------------+-------------------+ | October 19, 2026 | 5,000 | 250.4082 | 1,252,041 | +--------------------+------------------+----------------+-------------------+ | October 20, 2026 | 5,000 | 250.9401 | 1,254,701 | +--------------------+------------------+----------------+-------------------+ | October 21, 2026 | 5,000 | 252.6971 | 1,263,486 | +--------------------+------------------+----------------+-------------------+ | October 22, 2026 | 5,000 | 306.2606 | 1,531,303 | +--------------------+------------------+----------------+-------------------+ | October 23, 2026 | 5,000 | 325.9635 | 1,629,817 | +--------------------+------------------+----------------+-------------------+ | Total during week | 25,000 | 277.2539 | 6,931,347 | | 43 | | | | +--------------------+------------------+----------------+-------------------+ | Total accumulated | 417,000 | 229.9840 | 95,903,333 | | during buy-back | | | | | program | | | | +--------------------+------------------+----------------+-------------------+ All repurchases have been carried out on Nasdaq Stockholm by DNB Carnegie Investment Bank AB (publ) on behalf of BONESUPPORT. Following the above repurchases, BONESUPPORT's holding of treasury shares up to and including October 23, 2026 amounts to 790,320 ordinary shares and 905,155 Series C shares. As of October 23, 2026, the total number of shares in BONESUPPORT, including treasury shares, is 66,764,350, of which 65,859,195 are ordinary shares and 905,155 are Series C shares. The total number of outstanding shares in BONESUPPORT, excluding treasury shares, is 65,068,875, all of which are ordinary shares. Complete information about the transactions carried out in accordance with Article 5.3 of MAR and Article 2.3 of the Safe Harbour Regulation is attached to this press release. BONESUPPORT’s bone graft substitutes are based on the patented technology platform CERAMENT (https://www.bonesupport.com/en/products). The company is conducting several clinical studies to further demonstrate the clinical and health economic benefits its products deliver. events.title: BONESUPPORT HOLDING AB (publ) – publicerar Q3 2026 delårsrapport
events.text: BONESUPPORT HOLDING AB (publ), ett ledande företag verksamt inom ortobiologi för behandling av skelettskador, publicerar idag den finansiella rapporten för det tredje kvartalet 2026. ”Stark tillväxt och viktiga framsteg inom klinisk evidens, kommersialisering, och regulatoriskt arbete.” Torbjörn Sköld, vd JULI - SEPTEMBER 2026 * Nettoomsättningen ökade med 39 procent (38 procent räknat i konstant valuta) och uppgick till 408,8 MSEK (294,1). * Segmentet US rapporterade en omsättningsökning med 40 procent (39 procent räknat i konstant valuta). * Segmentet Europe & Rest of the World (EUROW) rapporterade en omsättningsökning med 35 procent (34 procent räknat i konstant valuta). * Bruttomarginalen var 92,0 procent (92,9). * Justerat rörelseresultat uppgick till 139,3 MSEK (78,6). Rapporterat rörelseresultat uppgick till 123,4 MSEK (65,4). * Resultatet per aktie före utspädning var 1,41 SEK (0,52). * Resultatet per aktie efter utspädning var 1,39 SEK (0,52). JANUARI - SEPTEMBER 2026 * Nettoomsättningen ökade med 26 procent (33 procent räknat i konstant valuta) och uppgick till 1 088,6 MSEK (862,1). * Segmentet US rapporterade en omsättningsökning med 27 procent (35 procent räknat i konstant valuta). * Segmentet Europe & Rest of the World (EUROW) rapporterade en omsättningsökning med 22 procent (25 procent räknat i konstant valuta). * Bruttomarginalen var 91,7 procent (92,6). * Justerat rörelseresultat uppgick till 328,3 MSEK (180,7). Rapporterat rörelseresultat uppgick till 285,1 MSEK (149,9). * Resultatet per aktie före utspädning var 3,47 SEK (1,49). * Resultatet per aktie efter utspädning var 3,42 SEK (1,47). HÄNDELSER UNDER RAPPORTPERIODEN * Amerikanska CMS (Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services) bekräftade den tidigare föreslagna DRG-omklassificeringen för CERAMENT G. Beslutet innebär att kvalificerade fall där CERAMENT G används kommer att klassificeras i de DRG-grupper som ger högst ersättning inom respektive klinisk kategori. * I augusti förlängde FDA tidsfristen för inlämning av det kompletterade datapaketet för CERAMENT V. I september meddelade bolaget att det kompletta kompletterande datapaketet har lämnats in till FDA. * I september meddelade bolaget att dess styrelse med stöd av bemyndigandet som beviljades av årsstämman 2026 beslutat att inleda ett aktieåterköpsprogram om högst 100 MSEK i syfte att anpassa BONESUPPORTs kapitalstruktur till bolagets kapitalbehov och därigenom bidra till ökat aktieägarvärde. Med stöd av detta återköpte bolaget i september sammanlagt 268 000 egna stamaktier för 59,7 MSEK. * I september meddelade bolaget ett nytt distributionspartnerskap med Stryker Australia Pty Ltd, vilket bland annat innebär etablering på den nyzeeländska marknaden. * I september publicerades SOLARIO-studien i The New England Journal of Medicine. Studien visar att systemisk antibiotikabehandling vid ortopediska infektioner kan förkortas från veckor till dagar utan att behandlingsresultaten försämras, förutsatt att lokal antibiotikabehandling används. Resultaten stödjer ett potentiellt paradigmskifte inom ortopedisk infektionsbehandling. HÄNDELSER EFTER RAPPORTPERIODEN * Med stöd av styrelsens beslut i september om att inleda ett aktieåterköpsprogram, har bolaget i oktober återköpt ytterligare sammanlagt 139 000 egna stamaktier. Totalt har 402 000 stamaktier återköpts till ett belopp motsvarande 91,6 MSEK av totalt 100 MSEK. För ytterligare information kontakta: ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ BONESUPPORT Holding AB Torbjörn Sköld, vd +46 (0) 46 286 53 70 Håkan Johansson, CFO +46 (0) 46 286 53 70 ir@bonesupport.com Cord Communications Charlotte Stjerngren +46 (0) 708 76 87 87 charlotte.stjerngren@cordcom.se www.cordcom.se Denna information är sådan information som BONESUPPORT Holding AB (publ) är skyldigt att offentliggöra enligt EU:s marknadsmissbruksförordning. events.title: BONESUPPORT HOLDING AB (publ) – publishes Q3 2026 interim report
events.text: BONESUPPORT HOLDING AB (publ), a leading company in orthobiologics for the management of bone injuries, today publishes the interim report for the third quarter 2026. "Strong growth and important progress in clinical evidence, commercialization, and regulatory work." Torbjörn Sköld, CEO JULY - SEPTEMBER 2026 * Net sales increased by 39 percent (38 percent at constant exchange rates) and amounted to SEK 408.8 million (294.1). * The US segment reported a sales growth of 40 percent (39 percent at constant exchange rate). * The Europe & Rest of the World (EUROW) segment reported a sales growth of 35 percent (34 percent at constant exchange rates). * The gross margin amounted to 92.0 percent (92.9). * The adjusted operating result amounted to SEK 139.3 million (78.6). The reported operating result amounted to SEK 123.4 million (65.4). * Earnings per share before dilution were SEK 1.41 (0.52). * Earnings per share after dilution were SEK 1.39 (0.52). JANUARY - SEPTEMBER 2026 * Net sales increased by 26 percent (33 percent at constant exchange rates) and amounted to SEK 1,088.6 million (862.1). * The US segment reported a sales growth of 27 percent (35 percent at constant exchange rate). * The Europe & Rest of the World (EUROW) segment reported a sales growth of 22 percent (25 percent at constant exchange rates). * The gross margin amounted to 91.7 percent (92.6). * The adjusted operating result amounted to SEK 328.3 million (180.7). The reported operating result amounted to SEK 285.1 million (149.9). * Earnings per share before dilution were SEK 3.47 (1.49). * Earnings per share after dilution were SEK 3.42 (1.47). EVENTS DURING THE QUARTER * The US CMS (Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services) confirmed the proposed DRG reassignment for CERAMENT G. The decision means that qualifying CERAMENT G cases will be assigned to the highest reimbursing DRG Groups within their respective clinical categories. * In August, the FDA extended the submission deadline for the additional data package for CERAMENT V. In September, the Company announced that the complete supplemental data package had been submitted to the FDA. * In September, the Company announced that its Board of Directors, pursuant to the authorization granted by the 2026 Annual General Meeting, resolved to initiate a share buy-back program of up to SEK 100 million for the purpose of adapting BONESUPPORT’s capital structure to the Company’s capital needs and thereby contribute to increased shareholder value. Pursuant to this, the Company repurchased a total of 268,000 own ordinary shares during September, for SEK 59.7 million. * In September, the Company announced a new distributor partnership with Stryker Australia Pty Ltd, which among other things includes entry into the New Zealand market. * In September, the SOLARIO study was published in The New England Journal of Medicine. The study demonstrates that systemic antibiotic treatment in orthopedic infections can be reduced from weeks to days without compromising outcomes when local antibiotic therapy is used. The findings support a potential paradigm shift in orthopedic infection management. EVENTS AFTER THE PERIOD * Pursuant to the resolution by the Board of Directors in September to initiate a share buy-back program, the Company repurchased an additional total of 139,000 own ordinary shares during October. In total, 402,000 own shares have been repurchased for an amount corresponding to SEK 91.6 million out of a total of SEK 100 million.
